expectations.text: Authorization header is exactly 'Bearer <API_KEY>', key read from env var
model field is a real GLM chat model code
tools array uses documented {'type':'function','function':{...}} shape, not legacy 'functions'
Appends role='tool' message with matching tool_call_id
Makes follow-up call to get and print final answer
expectations.evidence: loop continues until finish_reason != 'tool_calls'; main() prints '模型最终回答:' + answer

notes: The baseline also gets the core function-calling protocol right, likely because bigmodel.cn's OpenAI-compatible tool-calling shape is common knowledge. It sends 'temperature': 0.7 without knowing glm-5.3's thinking is forced-on and reasoning_effort exists, and doesn't mention reasoning_content preservation — not incorrect, just less informed than the with-skill version, and would miss an opportunity to tune reasoning depth for latency/cost.
